subject: Confirming Quantify Health request: opt-out of model learning & retention details
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@quantifyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps from today's product call — data handling & model learning

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have everything on the same page: 

- What we heard from Quantify Health: you want the pilot to run on Redwood's hosted inference, but you do NOT want any of customer traffic used to improve or fine-tune public models or Redwood's internal model training.
- Primary asks: (1) confirm "no training on customer data" for this account, (2) tighter log retention (shorter than default), (3) PII minimization and optional redaction, and (4) EU residency for logs is NOT required — US-only processing is acceptable for now.

Options we proposed on the call (and what I'll put into an addendum):
- Opt-out clause: Redwood will exclude Quantify Health data from any model-training pipelines and will not add it to any training corpora.
- Logging/retention: default 90 days can be shortened; we suggested 30 days but open to 45 if that's your security team's preference.
- Redaction: we can enable automatic redaction of direct identifiers (names, SSNs) before logs persist.
- Audit evidence: provide SOC 2 + a signed data-use addendum and optional regular export of audit logs scoped to your account.

Can you confirm these bullets reflect Quantify Health's position? If so, I'll prepare a short Data Use Addendum and send it for signature (DocuSign). Also looping in Marissa from our security-compliance track to help with evidence and the addendum language.

Next steps: 
1) Emma confirm opt-out and retention window (30/45/90).
2) Redwood sends addendum + DocuSign.
3) Quantify Health legal/security signs addendum; Redwood configures account (redaction + retention) and provides SOC2 snapshot + logging access.

Attachments: none on this message.

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's product call — data handling & model learning

Thanks Mina — this matches what we discussed. A couple clarifications from our side before you draft the addendum: 

- Confirmed: Quantify Health requires that our traffic NOT be used to train models (we're opting out). Please include explicit language that customer data will be excluded from training pipelines and any model improvement initiatives.
- Retention window: security prefers 45 days for logs instead of 30. Can Redwood accommodate 45 days as a max retention for request logs/audit traces tied to our account?
- PII handling: we want automatic redaction of direct identifiers and an option for us to request a sanitized export if we need it for debugging.
- Evidence: please include a SOC 2 snapshot and the name/email of the Redwood person who will be our contact for compliance evidence requests. We'll run the addendum by our counsel and security team.

Looping in Tom Rivera (security@quantifyhealth.com) who will own the final sign-off on retention/PII language. Tom — feel free to reply with any edits.

Thanks,
Emma

Emma / Tom — appreciate the quick confirmation. We will proceed as follows: 

1) Redwood will prepare a short Data Use Addendum with explicit opt-out language: "Quantify Health data will not be used to train models or for model improvement initiatives."
2) Retention window set to 45 days for request logs/audit traces. Logs will be configured to auto-delete after 45 days unless otherwise requested in writing.
3) PII handling: enable automatic redaction for direct identifiers; offer a sanitized export process for debugging (we will only provide sanitized exports under a signed request and with access controls).
4) Evidence: attaching a one-page addendum draft and a DocuSign link for signature. I'll also include a SOC 2 snapshot and point person for future evidence requests (Marissa Cole, marissa_cole@redwood.com).

Attachments: Quantify_Health_Data_Use_Addendum.pdf (draft), QH-MSA-Addendum-signature-link.txt (DocuSign URL).

Action items: 
- Tom: if you or your counsel want edits, reply to this thread with comments on the attached addendum.
- Emma: once signed, we'll configure the account and confirm the retention/redaction settings within 24 hours.

I'll follow up with the DocuSign envelope shortly.

Best,
Mina
